title: Data Analyst | Remote | Full-Time | $400/month (Negotiable)
description:
Data Analyst (Remote) — Channel Metrics, CTR & Performance Tracking 100% Remote (Work From Home)



Turn numbers into growth. We're hiring an Analyst who loves finding out what's working and why.

If you get a little thrill from spotting the exact reason a campaign is winning (or bleeding money), this role is for you. You'll be the person our marketing and finance teams rely on to tell them the truth behind the data — which channels earn, which CTAs convert, and where we can grow faster. No guessing. Just clear insights that drive real decisions.



What You'll Do



Track and report on channel performance: CTR, Average View Duration (AVD), impressions, clicks, conversions, and revenue vs. cost

Work side-by-side with our Accountant to analyze earnings vs. spend, calculate ROI/ROAS per channel, and flag what's profitable vs. what's losing money — then recommend how to fix or improve it

Partner with our Marketing team to measure how well CTAs perform across campaigns

Track attribution: the % of traffic, leads, and sales coming from QR codes, tracked links, and specific campaigns

Monitor and evaluate landing page performance (conversion rate, bounce, drop-off) and suggest improvements

Build clean, easy-to-read dashboards and reports that turn raw data into clear next steps

Run simple tests and comparisons (CTAs, links, creatives) to find what converts best



What We're Looking For



Comfortable with Google Sheets/Excel (formulas, pivot tables, clean reporting)

Understands core marketing metrics: CTR, CPC, ROAS, conversion rate, AVD

Familiar with analytics tools like Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, or YouTube Analytics — or eager to learn (we'll train the right person)

Detail-oriented and genuinely enjoys working with numbers

Clear written English for reporting and team collaboration

Reliable internet and a quiet remote work setup

Bonus: Looker Studio (Google Data Studio), UTM tracking, or QR/link-tracking experience

title: Real Estate AI Marketing & Content Manager
description:
I am looking for a Real Estate AI Marketing & Content Manager with at least 3 years' experience working with U.S. real estate professionals to help grow and manage the online marketing, branding, and social media presence for my real estate business.



This is not a basic VA role. I am looking for someone who already understands real estate marketing, can think strategically, create polished content, use AI tools to work efficiently, and proactively bring ideas to the table instead of waiting for step-by-step instructions.



You will be supporting a solo Realtor brand and helping market me, my listings, and my services across social media and related marketing platforms. I need someone who can combine content strategy, content creation, graphics, social media management, analytics, and selected marketing-tool execution into one strong role.



I am not looking for someone to simply “post on social media.” I’m looking for someone who can help strengthen my brand, improve my content strategy, create high-quality marketing assets, stay current with trends, analyze what’s working, and help turn social media into a more effective lead-generation and brand-building tool for my business.



If you are highly organized, creative, analytical, detail-oriented, and already have experience supporting Realtors or real estate brands with social media and digital marketing, I’d love to hear from you.



________________________________________



Hours / Availability

• This is an ongoing flexible role

• Must be able to overlap at least some hours between 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM CST

• Hours will depend on workload, performance, and overall fit

• I care more about quality, ownership, strategy, and results than simply filling a set number of hours

• For the right person, there is room for the role to grow over time based on business needs and demonstrated value

________________________________________



What I Need Help With

Your primary focus will be helping me build a stronger, smarter, more consistent marketing engine for my real estate business.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1) Social Media Strategy & Content Planning

• Develop and manage a strategic content calendar for my real estate brand

• Plan content for
, Instagram, TikTok, Google Business Profile, and YouTube

• Create content that helps market:

o me as a Realtor / personal brand

o my listings

o my real estate services

o buyer and seller education

o local market expertise / local lifestyle content

o lead generation and trust-building content

• Bring proactive ideas for campaigns, content angles, social growth, and brand positioning

• Help identify what content should be posted, why, and how it supports business goals



2) Content Creation, Repurposing & Publishing

• Create and repurpose short-form and long-form real estate content

• Turn listing details, property features, market updates, FAQs, voice notes, and rough ideas into strong social content

• Create content such as:

o listing promo posts

o reels / short videos

o carousel posts

o educational buyer/seller content

o market update content

o branded social graphics

o story content

o review / testimonial / social proof content

• Help maintain a consistent posting rhythm and organized publishing workflow across priority platforms



3) Graphic Design & Video / Reel Editing

• Create polished, branded graphics and marketing pieces in Canva (and other tools if applicable)

• Design materials such as:

o just listed / open house / price improvement / under contract / sold graphics

o listing marketing graphics

o educational carousels and branded posts

o story graphics and promotional assets

o lead magnet / campaign graphics

o YouTube thumbnails / reel covers if needed

• Edit short-form videos / reels for social media

• Help maintain a strong, consistent visual brand across platforms



4) Analytics, Reporting & Content Optimization

• Track social media performance and help analyze what is and is not working

• Review content performance and provide recommendations on:

o content topics and themes

o hooks and messaging

o engagement trends

o audience growth

o content formats to repeat or improve

o ways to improve reach, quality, and consistency

• Help identify what content deserves to be doubled down on vs dropped

• Support tracking through tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, and other relevant platform analytics



5) Community Management & Brand Presence

• Help monitor comments, messages, engagement, and audience interactions

• Support community management and help maintain a professional, responsive online presence

• Help maximize reviews, testimonials, and social proof where appropriate



6) Real Estate Marketing Tools & Marketing System Support

• Help manage marketing-related tasks inside tools such as:

o Listings to Leads

o Ylopo

o Publer

o other real estate marketing tools as needed

• Support marketing campaigns, lead-gen assets, social promotion, landing pages, and branded materials tied to these tools

• Help keep marketing systems organized and functioning smoothly

________________________________________



SECONDARY / PREFERRED RESPONSIBILITIES

These are valuable, but they are not the main reason I’m hiring. If you already have experience in these areas, that is a plus:

• SEO-related marketing support

• keyword research / basic on-page SEO understanding

• meta-tagging / geo-tagging / image metadata support

• Meta /
 ads support

• ManyChat / chatbot-related marketing support

• online research tied to content, marketing, or SEO

• light real estate marketing admin support as needed

________________________________________



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE / SKILLS

• Experience supporting a Realtor, real estate team, brokerage, or real estate brand with social media and/or digital marketing

• Strong understanding of real estate content and marketing, including how to market:

o listings

o buyer and seller services

o educational real estate content

o a personal brand as a Realtor

• Strong Canva skills and ability to create polished, professional graphics

• Experience creating short-form content and editing reels/videos for social media

• Comfortable using AI tools to support content ideation, repurposing, caption writing, workflow efficiency, and content creation

• Ability to think strategically and bring ideas proactively

• Strong written English and ability to create clean, professional marketing copy

• Detail-oriented and organized

• Able to follow written and verbal instructions well

• Strong sense of ownership and follow-through

• Must be able to work independently and not wait to be told every tiny next step

________________________________________



PREFERRED TOOLS / EXPERIENCE

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

• Listings to Leads

• Ylopo

• Canva

• Adobe Photoshop

• Google Workspace / Google Suite

• Publer

• Meta Business Suite

• Google Analytics

• SEMrush / SEO tools

• ManyChat

• MLS systems such as Paragon and FlexMLS

• AI tools for content creation, repurposing, video editing, research, and workflow support

________________________________________



IMPORTANT: THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF…

• You need constant direction and are waiting for me to tell you exactly what to do every day

• You do not already understand the basics of real estate marketing

• You do not enjoy thinking strategically about content and brand growth

• Your work is rushed, sloppy, or full of avoidable mistakes

• You only know how to do basic posting but not actual content planning, repurposing, graphics, or performance analysis

________________________________________



COMPENSATION

Compensation depends on experience, portfolio quality, and overall fit for the role.

________________________________________



TO APPLY

Please send:

1. Your resume

2. A short note explaining your experience working with Realtors, real estate brands, or real estate marketing

3. Examples of real estate social media content, graphics, or marketing materials you’ve created

4. A list of AI tools you currently use for content creation, repurposing, editing, analytics, or workflow efficiency — and how you use them

5. A short explanation of how you would help a solo Realtor improve their social media presence and content strategy

6. Your desired hourly rate

7. Your weekly availability

Please include the phrase “Real Estate Marketing Pro” in your application subject line or first message so I know you read the full job post.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
ABOUT BIGGER THAN CULTURE



Bigger Than Culture is a London-based debate media brand. We run Hearts & Minds — a live, ticketed debate series — and produce short-form debate content built for social. Our defining principle is strict neutrality: we never take a side on a motion. We frame both sides fairly, put the argument in front of the audience, and let them d
.



We're building a media company, not just an events brand. Social content, live events, and community are three connected pillars — and social is the engine that drives the other two.



"Agree or disagree?" — every piece of content we publish is an invitation to the audience to make up their own mind.



THE ROLE



You will own Bigger Than Culture's entire social operation across five platforms: Instagram Reels (our lead platform), TikTok, X, YouTube Shorts, and YouTube long-form. That means running the daily publishing calendar, protecting the brand's editorial standards, managing our community, directing our virtual assistant, and reporting on what's working — with the autonomy to make calls and the judgement to flag the ones that need a founder's eye.



This is a hands-on role for someone who understands debate and commentary culture, has genuinely sharp editorial instincts, and can hold a neutral line on contested topics without making the content boring.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



Content & Publishing

- Run the publishing calendar: three posts daily on Instagram, with native Hearts & Minds content going out twice weekly (Wednesday and Sunday, 7pm UK).

- Mirror Instagram content to X within one hour of posting — native uploads only, never watermarked shares. Manage native distribution to TikTok and YouTube Shorts.

- Oversee YouTube long-form: 10-minute debate segments cut from Hearts & Minds events.

- Write captions to house rules: forward-looking framing, no promotion of past events, maximum five hashtags always including #BiggerThanCulture.

- Source and clip external debate content, crediting original creators in the caption.



Editorial Standards & Brand Protection

- Hold the neutrality line in every caption, comment, and reply — the brand never takes a side on a motion, ever.

- Ensure every motion statement is grounded in what the speaker actually argued — verified against captions or audio, never inferred or assumed.

- Keep visual output on-brand: the dark, premium, editorial aesthetic and the BTC video template are non-negotiable.



Community & Moderation

- Own comment and DM strategy across platforms, driving debate in the comments without steering it.

- Repost audience reactions and event content to Stories; engage with the wider debate content ecosystem from the brand account.

- Set and enforce moderation thresholds; know when to delete, when to let an argument run, and when to escalate.



Team & Process

- Manage and brief our virtual assistant: posting schedules, response protocols, and the AI prompt library for comments and DMs.

- Own the scheduling tools and content folder system so nothing goes out late and nothing goes out wrong.



Live Events

- Plan and direct content capture at Hearts & Minds events — knowing before doors open which 
nts you need and how they'll be cut.

- Drive ticket sales for upcoming events through the content calendar.



Performance

- Deliver a weekly performance report against agreed KPIs: growth, reach, engagement, and ticket conversion.

- Scout trends in debate, commentary, and culture content — and turn them into formats before they peak.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Essential

- Proven track record growing a brand or creator account on Instagram Reels and TikTok.

- Sharp editorial judgement on contested, culturally sensitive topics — and the discipline to stay neutral on them.

- Strong short-form copywriting; captions that spark comment-section debate.

- Experience managing a content calendar and briefing others (VA, editors, or freelancers).

- Fluent in analytics across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

- Available for evening event coverage in London.



Nice to Have

- Video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar) and an eye for hook-first clip structure.

- Background in debate, journalism, politics, or commentary media.

- Experience with community moderation at scale.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted workflows for community management.

- Live events or ticketing experience (Eventbrite, Posh).

title: UX Designer – eCommerce & Conversion Rate Optimization
description:
We are looking for a UX Designer who truly understands how users behave — and how great design directly drives revenue.



This role is NOT about making things look pretty. It's about making things WORK.



---



WHO WE ARE



We are a performance-driven eCommerce team. Every design decision we make is measured by one question: Does it convert? We believe in data-backed design, clean user flows, and removing every possible barrier between a visitor and a purchase. UX at our company is a growth tool — not a decoration department.



---



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Design and optimize UX flows for eCommerce stores (product pages, PDPs, checkout, cart, landing pages)

- Identify conversion bottlenecks and propose testable, hypothesis-driven solutions

- Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups in Figma

- Conduct UX audits on existing stores and present actionable improvements

- Collaborate closely with our team to implement and A/B test design changes

- Stay current with eCommerce UX best practices, CRO frameworks, and buyer psychology



---



OUR UX PRINCIPLES (Read carefully — this defines how we work)



1. Function over aesthetics. A beautiful design that doesn't convert is a failed design. Every element must serve a purpose.

2. Less friction, more revenue. We remove every unnecessary click, scroll, and decision from the user's path to purchase.

3. Design for the user, not for yourself. We don't care if something looks clever. We care if it works for real customers.

4. Data is your compass. Gut feeling is a starting point — not a conclusion. We test, measure, and iterate.

5. Clarity beats creativity. If a user has to think twice, we've already lost them.

6. Mobile-first, always. The majority of eCommerce traffic is mobile. If it doesn't work perfectly on mobile, it doesn't ship.

7. Speed matters. Every second of load time costs conversions. Design must consider performance.



---



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Strong experience in UX design for eCommerce (Shopify, WooCommerce, or similar platforms)

- Solid understanding of Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) principles and best practices

- Proficiency in Figma — you must be able to design and prototype natively in Figma

- Ability to think in user journeys, funnels, and behavioral patterns

- Knowledge of A/B testing concepts (Hotjar, Google Optimize, VWO, or similar tools is a plus)

- Strong eye for UX copy — microcopy, CTAs, and headlines that convert

- Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and meet deadlines



---



HOW TO APPLY — IMPORTANT: Applications without a video will NOT be considered.



To apply, you must submit a short video (2–5 minutes) in which you:



1. Walk us through at least one Figma UX design you created for an eCommerce context (product page, checkout, landing page, etc.)

2. Explain WHY you made specific design decisions — focus on conversion and user behavior, not aesthetics

3. If you don't have existing eCommerce projects: Pick any real online store, identify a UX/CRO problem on it, and show us how you would redesign or improve it in Figma. We are more interested in how you THINK than what you've already done.



Your video should demonstrate: clear thinking, knowledge of eCommerce UX, and a conversion-first mindset.



No video = no review. This is non-negotiable.



---



We look forward to meeting designers who design with purpose.

You'll also own review generation and management, since strong SEO and strong review velocity go hand in hand.



What You'll Do

Local SEO (all retainer tiers):



Google Business Profile setup, optimization, and ongoing management

Local citation building and NAP consistency across directories

Local keyword research specific to each client's service area and trade

Automated review generation setup (post-job request flows) and review response management



On-page & technical SEO (web builds):



On-page optimization for new Starter, Growth, and Signature Build sites (title tags, meta descriptions, header structure, internal linking)

Technical SEO audits — site speed, mobile usability, schema markup, crawlability — especially on custom Supabase-backed builds where standard SEO plugins don't apply

Ensure new landing pages (service pages, location pages, seasonal pages) are built SEO-first from day one, not retrofitted after launch



Ongoing (Growth & Partner retainer tiers):



Monthly SEO reporting tied to actual ranking and lead volume, not just vanity metrics

Content recommendations for blog/service pages that support the local SEO strategy

Competitor gap analysis within each client's specific trade and county



Platforms & Tools You Should Know

SEO research & tracking:



Google Search Console and Google Analytics (required)

Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Moz (at least one required for keyword research and rank tracking)

Screaming Frog for technical/crawl audits



Local SEO & citations:



Google Business Profile Manager (required)

BrightLocal or Whitespark for citation building and rank tracking

Yext or similar for listing management (nice to have)



Review generation & reputation:



Experience with a review automation platform (e.g., Podium, NiceJob, Birdeye, or similar) — tool flexibility is fine, but you should understand the workflow



Technical/schema:



Schema markup implementation (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQ schema) — via Google's Structured Data tools or similar

Basic familiarity with PageSpeed Insights / Core Web Vitals



Reporting:



Comfortable building clear client-facing reports in Google Sheets, Looker Studio, or a similar dashboard tool



What We're Looking For



Proven experience with local SEO for small businesses — please include examples of ranking improvements or GBP profiles you've managed, with before/after data

Understanding of technical SEO fundamentals — you don't need to code, but you need to know what to ask a developer for

Home services or local trades experience strongly preferred — the keyword and content strategy here is different from e-commerce or national SEO

Strong written English for reporting and content recommendations

Comfortable managing SEO across multiple client accounts simultaneously (agency experience preferred)



How to Apply

Send us:



A short intro (2–3 sentences) on your SEO experience — local, technical, or both

1–2 examples of ranking or GBP improvements you've driven, with before/after data if possible

Which of the tools above you have hands-on experience with

title: UK Public Sector Bid Writer & Tender Manager
description:
UK PUBLIC SECTOR BID WRITER & TENDER MANAGER



Remote | Part-Time (up to 20 hrs/week) | Hybrid Pay + Uncapped Rev Share



Pay Structure — Read This First

Before you read anything else, understand how this role pays. It's built for genuine specialists who want real upside, not for generalists looking for stable hourly work.



- Base pay: $8 USD per hour, up to 20 hours per week (about $640/month).

- Rev share: 5% of first year's revenue on every UK public sector contract you write that we win. No cap. Paid as we invoice.

- Instant win bonus: $500 USD paid the day a contract is awarded, before we've invoiced anything.

- Big win bonus: £2,000 GBP additional bonus for any single contract worth £250,000 or more.



Framework panel bonus: £3,000 GBP paid the day JKN is confirmed on any framework panel worth £5M+ in total value. Paid regardless of whether call-offs land later.

What that means in real numbers



- Win a £50,000 contract: $500 instant + £2,500 rev share = £2,900+ total

- Win a £150,000 contract: $500 instant + £7,500 rev share = £7,900+ total

- Win a £250,000+ contract: $500 instant + £2,000 big-win bonus + £12,500+ rev share = £15,000+ total

- Get JKN onto a £10M framework panel: £3,000 panel bonus + ongoing rev share on call-off contracts for the framework life (3-4 years). Typically £5,000-£25,000+ total over framework life



Win a framework worth £500,000 in year one: $500 instant + £3,000 framework bonus + £25,000 rev share = £28,000+ total (about $35,000

EARNINGS OUTLOOK If you're good at this and we work together for a year, you should earn between $20,000 and $50,000 USD. That's what this role is designed to deliver for the right person.



About JKN Digital



We are JKN Digital Limited, an established UK large format print and signage company based in the North of England. Founded in 1988. We currently print for multi-site retail, hospitality, and brand clients across the UK, including some of the biggest names in British business.

We're now entering the UK public sector market. Local councils, NHS trusts, universities, housing associations, and central government departments all spend millions every year on printed signage, wayfinding, POS, banners, and vehicle graphics. That's where you come in.

We already have the operational capability, the case studies, the credentials, and the samples. What we don't have is a specialist who lives and breathes UK public procurement. That's the role.



What You'll Do



- You will run our end-to-end UK public sector tendering process:

- Monitor UK tender portals daily for opportunities matching our capability.

- Filter opportunities and present a weekly shortlist of "worth bidding" tenders with clear reasoning.

- Write full bid responses end-to-end: technical, quality, social value, executive summaries.

- Manage the entire submission process on each portal, including uploads, forms, clarifications, and hitting deadlines.

- Chase post-tender debriefs on every loss and feed lessons back into future bids.

- Build and maintain our bid library, evidence files, and case studies.

- Report weekly on pipeline, submissions, wins, losses, and what we should do next.



You are the specialist. We defer to you on public sector strategy. We give you the raw materials and the sign-off. You run the process.



Our Target Contract Zone

Focus your effort where JKN can genuinely win. Not the tiny contracts, not the giant ones.



- Primary target: individual contracts between £250,000 and £1,000,000. This is JKN's sweet spot on financial covenants, operational scale, and competitive positioning.



- Highest priority: framework agreements worth £5M+ total (across all appointed suppliers). Getting JKN onto framework panels is the single most valuable outcome of your work. Framework panels generate call-off contracts for 3-4 years without further competitive bidding.



- Secondary target: multi-lot contracts with smaller lots (sub-£1M) that JKN can bid on individually.



- Do not bid on: single contracts under £50k (not worth the effort), single contracts over £2M (JKN's scale doesn't credibly compete), or specifications that are clearly written for a specific incumbent supplier.



Mandatory Experience



Read this carefully. Applications missing any of the following will be rejected without review.



- Minimum 3 years' professional experience writing UK public sector bids. Non-UK public sector experience does not qualify. Private sector bids do not qualify.



- Direct hands-on experience with at least 5 of these portals: Find a Tender, Contracts Finder, YORtender, The Chest, NEPO, Proactis, Delta eSourcing, In-Tend, ProContract, NHS Sourcing Platform.



- Fluent, native-standard written English at UK public sector formal register. Your writing must be indistinguishable from a UK-born writer's.



Working knowledge of UK procurement terminology: PQQ, ITT, SQ, DPS, framework agreement, sub-lot, call-off, mini-competition, PPN 06/20 social value, TOMs (Themes, Outcomes, Measures), Public Contracts Regulations, MEAT scoring.

Proof of Past Wins — Verifiable, No Exceptions

You must provide evidence of at least 3 UK public sector contracts you have personally written and won for previous clients or employers. For each, we require:



1.Winning company name (yours or the client's)



2. Contracting authority (specific council, NHS trust, university, etc.)



3. Approximate contract value



4. Year of award



Plus ONE of these three as proof for each contract:



- Copy of the award letter or contract notice from the contracting authority (redact commercial confidentiality only).



- Written reference from the winning company we can contact to verify.



- Public link to the tender award notice on Find a Tender or Contracts Finder that we can independently verify.

NO EXCEPTIONS "Confidential, cannot share" is not acceptable. We understand commercial confidentiality, but at least one verifiable case is a hard requirement. If you can't prove what you've done, this role isn't for you.

Desirable (Nice to Have)



- Bid writing for print, signage, graphics, or facilities management specifically.



- Framework and DPS applications, including Crown Commercial Service frameworks.



- Experience with G-Cloud or other national procurement frameworks.



What We Provide



- Full access to JKN's UK company documentation: financials, ISO evidence, insurance certificates, environmental and safety policies, case studies, portfolio, and physical samples.



- Direct access to the owner (Wilko) and sales manager (Hassan) for factual questions and bid sign-off.



- A JKN Digital
 address so you represent us professionally.



- Payment in USD via Wise or Payoneer.



- A partner-style working relationship, not agency churn.



How We Work



- Up to 20 hours per week, flexible schedule.



- Minimum 4-hour daily overlap with UK working hours (9am to 5pm GMT/BST).



- 2-hour response window during your working hours.



- Weekly video sync with Wilko or Hassan.



Application Requirements



5. Applications missing any of the following will be rejected without review. Do not send partial applications.



6. Your CV with dates, employers, and specific detail on UK public sector bid writing experience.



7. Your list of 3+ verifiable UK public sector wins (as described above).



8. Names and current work
s of 2 UK-based references we can contact (managers, clients, or contracting authority contacts).



A 400-word writing sample answering this question:



WRITING SAMPLE QUESTION "Please describe your organisation's approach to quality management on multi-site UK-wide print rollouts, including how you ensure brand consistency across

geographically dispersed sites and how you handle production issues without impacting client deadlines. Structure your answer for a formal UK public sector bid response. 400 words maximum."



9. Do not use AI to write this. We run every sample through GPTZero and Originality.ai. AI-detected writing means immediate rejection.



Written confirmation that you accept the hybrid pay structure, 20 hours per week availability, 4-hour daily UK overlap, and 2-hour response window.



Assessment Process



10. Application review (5 days): We check your application against the mandatory requirements. Missing anything means rejection.



11. Reference calls (3 days): We contact your 2 UK references before proceeding.



12. Independent verification (3 days): We verify at least one of your named past wins independently.



13. Paid trial task (5 days): We pay you $75 USD to complete a real 3-hour task: assess a live UK tender we choose, write a bid/no-bid recommendation with reasoning, and draft a 500-word technical response for that specific tender. This is where we see your actual work.



14. Video interview (1 day): 45 minutes with Wilko. Discussion of past wins, approach, and how we'll work together.



15. Contract offer: 30-day trial period at full pay structure. Rev share applies to any contract won during the trial.

Who Shouldn't Apply



You've never written a UK public sector bid but are willing to learn. This is a specialist role, not a training opportunity.



You've written private sector bids only. Public sector is a completely different discipline.



You can't verify your past wins. We won't accept "trust me."



You use AI or ChatGPT to write bid responses.



You want stable salaried work with no volatility. This role has modest base pay and high upside by design.



Why This Role, Why Now



You've probably worked at a UK bid consultancy or as a subcontractor to one. You've written winning bids that other people got credit for. You've watched account managers collect commissions on deals you won for them.

This role is different. Your name goes on the win. Your rev share reflects the value you create. And if we grow this pipeline together, you grow with it.



We're not looking for cheap labour. We're looking for a partner who wants to build something over the next few years.



How to Apply



Send everything in one
 to [YOUR
 ADDRESS].

Subject line: UK Bid Writer Application – [YOUR FULL NAME]

We respond to all complete applications within 5 working days. Applications close [30 days from posting].



End of job specification



P.S - I am more than happy to sign an NDA if you need me to do this, so you are able to send me proof of contract previously won with other companies.

title: Service Dispatch & Assigner

Job Overview

Are you a master multi-tasker who thrives in a fast-paced environment? Do you love solving the daily puzzle of logistics while keeping both field technicians and customers happy?



We are seeking a sharp, highly organized Service Dispatcher & Assigner to serve as the air traffic control for our field operations across Texas and Minnesota. In this role, you will be the primary link between our customers, our field technicians, and our internal management team. You’ll be responsible for maximizing our tech efficiency, keeping data pristine, and ensuring our daily operations run like a well-oiled machine.



If you are calm under pressure, quick on your feet, and love a dynamic workday where no two days are exactly the same, we want to hear from you!



Key Responsibilities

1. Daily Job Dispatch & Routing

Smart Scheduling: Assign incoming jobs to the right technician based on priority, geographic location (TX/MN), and real-time technician availability.

Route Optimization: Build and continuously adjust daily schedules to maximize technician efficiency and minimize downtime.

Real-Time Adjustments: Pivot and reroute jobs on the fly to handle last-minute cancellations, no-shows, or urgent emergencies.

2. Technician Communication & Support

Field Support: Act as the primary point of contact for technicians throughout the day—confirming job details, answering questions, and helping troubleshoot on-site scheduling issues.

Live Updates: Seamlessly push schedule changes and high-priority jobs out to technicians as they happen.

Status Tracking: Closely monitor technician statuses (en route, on-site, completed, available) to ensure all dispatch decisions are made using real-time data.

3. Customer Communication

Expectation Management: Confirm appointment windows, handle reschedule requests, and proactively notify customers if a technician is running behind.

First Contact: Serve as the first line of communication for customer scheduling questions.

Smart Escalation: Identify and escalate larger customer issues (complaints, disputes, urgent escalations) to the appropriate manager instead of trying to solve everything solo.

4. Job Data Accuracy

Data Integrity: Log job outcomes (sold, cancelled, callback, rescheduled, etc.) into our tracking sheets accurately and on the same day.

Proactive Auditing: Flag discrepancies in job statuses, technician assignments, or missing information before they impact downstream reporting.

Note: This data feeds every major company report, so accuracy and timeliness are critical parts of this role.

5. Cross-Department Coordination

Team Collaboration: Work daily alongside our Customer Service Representatives (CSRs), Operations, and Appointment Setting teams.

Feedback Loop: Partner with technicians on their job tracking and necessary follow-ups.

Eyes & Ears on the Ground: Flag technician performance trends, scheduling conflicts, or process gaps directly to the Operations Manager.



What We Are Looking For

Preferred Requirements:

Experience: Previous background in dispatch, scheduling, a call center, or another fast-paced, field-facing coordination role.

Multi-tasking Maestro: A strong multi-tasker who stays calm, cool, and organized when the schedule changes rapidly.

Communication Skills: Clear, friendly, and professional communicator who is equally comfortable talking to a technician in the field as they are with a customer on the phone.

Phone Stamina: Comfortable being on the phone and text/chat platforms for the majority of the workday.

Tech-Savvy: Basic comfort with spreadsheets and CRM tools, with a strong willingness to master our core tech stack (Workiz, Google Sheets, Google Chat).

Problem-Solver: An independent thinker who can make reasonable calls on reroutes and reschedules without needing every minor decision escalated.



Bonus Points (Optional):

Experience in home services, field services, or the trades (HVAC, plumbing, garage doors, electrical, etc.).

Familiarity with Workiz or similar field service management software.

Experience dispatching across multiple markets, time zones, or regions.

- If you have any experience working in a home improvement industry such as HVAC, Garage Door, Plumbing, etc. 

- A vocaroo recording of a short introduction about yourself 



Failure to comply will disregard your application.

title: Senior Bookkeeper / Finance Officer (Australian Accounting)
description:
Senior Bookkeeper / Finance Officer (Australian Accounting)

Full-Time | Remote

---

Join a Growing Australian Business Group

AFSC Group is an Australian-owned business operating across aviation, commercial real estate, treasury, investments, and other growing ventures.



We're looking for an experienced Senior Bookkeeper / Finance Officer to support the day-to-day financial operations across multiple Australian business entities.



This is not an entry-level position.



We're seeking someone who already has strong Australian bookkeeping experience and can confidently manage finance responsibilities with minimal supervision. This role is designed for a senior finance professional who enjoys taking ownership, solving problems, improving systems, and contributing beyond traditional bookkeeping.



If you're looking for a role where you can make an impact, work closely with management, and grow alongside a dynamic business group, we'd love to hear from you.

---

About the Role

As our Senior Bookkeeper / Finance Officer, you'll play an important role in supporting the finance operations across multiple Australian businesses.



This position combines hands-on bookkeeping with broader finance administration responsibilities, including fund transfers, loan management, Div. 7A administration, treasury support, compliance activities, and continuous process improvement.



As you become familiar with the business, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to finance projects, automation initiatives, and operational improvements that help the business scale efficiently.

---

Target Candidate

We're looking for someone who has:

- Minimum 7+ years of relevant bookkeeping and finance experience.

- CPA qualification is preferred but not essential.

- Strong experience supporting Australian businesses.

- Excellent knowledge of Australian bookkeeping and accounting practices.

- Strong experience using Xero.

- Experience working across multiple entities or complex business structures.

- Excellent reconciliation skills and attention to detail.

- Strong organizational and time management skills.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- A proactive mindset with the confidence to take ownership and make informed decisions.

- Interest in technology, automation, AI tools, and continuous process improvement.



Please note: This role is best suited for experienced finance professionals. Applicants seeking junior or entry-level bookkeeping positions may find this role beyond their current level of experience.

---

Nature of the Role

- 40% – Bookkeeping

- Maintain accurate financial records while ensuring all bookkeeping activities are completed efficiently and on time.

- Responsibilities include:

- Manage day-to-day bookkeeping using Xero.

- Process Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR).

- Perform bank, credit card, loan, and intercompany reconciliations.

- Complete month-end processing and reconciliations.

- Assist with BAS preparation and compliance requirements.

- Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.

- Prepare reconciliation schedules and ensure records remain audit-ready.

---

- 40% – Finance Administration

- Support the day-to-day finance function across multiple entities by ensuring financial transactions and records are accurate, - organized, and compliant.

- Responsibilities include:

- Prepare Director's Declarations (DD) and finance documentation.

- Manage intercompany loans and related transactions.

- Initiate and monitor bank payments and fund transfers.

- Assist with Div. 7A administration and supporting documentation.

- Maintain loan registers, finance trackers, and internal records.

- Support treasury and cash management activities.

- Coordinate with accountants, auditors, and management as required.

---

- 20% – Finance Operations & Process Improvement

- As you become familiar with our business, you'll have opportunities to contribute beyond day-to-day finance administration.

- Responsibilities include:

- Monitor Accounts Receivable (AR), including lease payments and outstanding balances.

- Support finance-related projects and operational initiatives.

- Identify opportunities to improve finance processes and workflows.

- Assist with automation initiatives using AI and other technology solutions.

- Help optimize finance systems, documentation, and internal procedures.

- Recommend practical improvements that increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

---

Decision-Making & Ownership

At AFSC Group, we value people who take ownership.



We're looking for someone who doesn't simply complete tasks but takes responsibility for outcomes.



In this role, you'll be trusted to:

- Manage your day-to-day responsibilities with minimal supervision.

- Prioritize work effectively while meeting deadlines.

- Identify issues, discrepancies, or risks early.

- Recommend practical solutions and process improvements.

- Communicate proactively with management and stakeholders.

- Deliver accurate, reliable, and timely work.

- Continuously improve finance processes and operational efficiency.



Success in this role comes from accountability, initiative, professionalism, and continuous improvement.

---

What Success Looks Like

You'll know you're succeeding when:

- Financial records are accurate, complete, and always up to date.

- Bookkeeping and reconciliations are completed without backlogs.

- Month-end deadlines are consistently achieved.

- Fund transfers and finance administration are managed accurately.

- Loan schedules and Div. 7A records are maintained correctly.

- Compliance obligations are completed accurately and on time.

- Finance processes continue to improve through your contributions.

- Management can confidently rely on the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of your work.

---

Why Join AFSC Group?

This is more than a bookkeeping position.



You'll gain exposure to multiple Australian businesses while working closely with management on finance operations, treasury support, commercial property, investments, compliance, and business process improvement.



You'll also have opportunities to contribute to automation initiatives and AI-driven operational improvements as the business continues to grow.

---

Working Arrangement

- Full-Time Remote Position

- Australian-Owned Business Group

- Long-Term Career Opportunity

- Supportive and Collaborative Team

- Opportunity for Professional Growth and Development

---

How to Apply

Please send us:

- Your updated resume

- A brief introduction about yourself

- Your experience using Xero

- Your experience supporting Australian businesses

- Your expected salary

- Your earliest available start date

- Any current commitments that may affect your working hours

To: 
 

 Subject:

I Am Your Next Senior Bookkeeper / Finance Officer

No crash diets or 30-day miracles. Our content, ads and free resources bring in a steady stream of people who already want help. Your job is to be the first person they talk to.



The role

You will run our Instagram DMs. Ads and free guides (our lead magnets) bring people into the inbox every day. You reply fast, have a real conversation, work out whether we can genuinely help them, and book the good fits onto a call with our team. You are not selling in the DMs and you are never pushy. You are the friendly, switched-on first impression of a brand people already trust.



Day to day that looks like: answering new leads quickly, following up everyone who downloads one of our guides, asking good questions about their goal and their situation, being upfront about what coaching involves and costs, booking calls, sending reminders so people actually show up, and keeping the lead sheet tidy.



You need to know your stuff

You do not need to be a qualified coach, but you must know training and nutrition basics well enough to hold a real conversation: what a calorie deficit is, why protein matters, what progressive overload means, why fat loss and muscle building are usually separate phases. If someone asks whether they can grow their glutes while losing fat, you should have a sensible, honest answer and know when to say that is exactly what the call is for. If you train and track your own food, you will feel at home here.



We are looking for someone who

Writes naturally and warmly, and sounds like a person, never a script

Is organised and obsessive about follow-up, because speed and consistency win this role

Can cover split shifts across the week including some evenings and weekend windows (AEST)

Has setting, sales, customer service or coaching-adjacent experience (a plus, not a must)

Is honest enough to tell someone we are not the right fit when we are not



Pay

Monthly retainer plus commission on every booked call that shows up, with tiered rates that climb when your volume and show rate are strong, plus a bonus for every client who signs from a call you booked. Realistic earnings are $2,000 to $4,500 AUD per month depending on performance. Full structure shared at interview.



How to apply

Send us a DM on 
 with: (1) a message or voice memo on why this role suits you, (2) one or two lines on your own training or education within our niche industry, and (3) start a convo with us 



(we are going to respond as a potential client and your aim is to qualify us and move us toward a booked call)' We read every application. The reply to the test messages matters more than your resume.



"Hey Koben!



Thanks for reaching out.



I would love to know motivated you to take action? (the ad, obviously. but why now?)



If you could achieve one thing over the next 3 months with us what would it be?



Hattie x"



From that 
nt we are roleplaying as a potential client, and your job is to do exactly what this role does every day: have a real conversation, qualify us, and move us to a booked call.



What we mean by qualify: by the end of the conversation you should genuinely know our goal, what's driving us to change now, what we're currently doing for training and food, what's been getting in the way, and whether we're actually ready to start and in a position to commit to coaching. If you can highlight some road blocks on the way this is also great, diagnosing without giving away too much as it will be the purpose of the sales call.



That last one matters and it's the one most people fumble. Do not quote prices and do not ask us what we can afford. Your job is to work out whether the investment of money, time and effort is right for us and whether we're in a position to say yes, without ever making it feel like a wallet check. How you get there is up to you, and that's exactly what we're watching.



The finish line: once you're confident we're a fit, book us in. Send a booking link with a line that makes us want to show up (any placeholder link is fine for this exercise, we're assessing the move, not the URL).



the conversation matters more than your resume. If you can make two coaches who do this for a living feel understood and happy to book a call, you can do this job.

title: Executive Operations Assistant (US Team)
description:
Most VA jobs are boring and treat you like a robot. This one's the opposite.



You already know the tools. GHL, ads, automations, all of it. But every job you've had just hands you a checklist and tells you to sit down and do it. No ownership, nothing that's actually yours.



That's not this.



I'm hiring one person to be my right hand and eventually do everything I do, so I can focus on the strategy while you run the actual operations. Funnels, ads, automations, reporting, helping me manage the team, finding leads, catching problems before they land on my desk.



I built this business and I care about it more than anything, so I'm not looking for someone who clocks in and waits for instructions. I want someone who treats it like it's theirs. Whoever's good at this sticks around for years and grows into a real partner here. That's the whole point.



You must be:

- 3+ years experience as an EA/VA — NOT a beginner. You help me manage; I don't manage you.

- An EXPERT in GoHighLevel, Claude Code OR Codex (you use AI every single day)

- Highly confident in Meta Ads Manager

- Comfortable with Make / Zapier

- Familiar with Slack and ClickUp

- Perfect written and spoken English

- Available 40 hours/week on US hours



Bonus (not required, but amazing): Vercel, Supabase, GitHub with Claude/Codex.



Who you are:

You're hungry and looking to prove yourself. You want to own your work and go above and beyond because you actually care. You have a brain and you use it; you're not a yes-sir/no-sir order-taker. You want to grind. Overtime isn't a burden to you, it's a sign you're building something. You've never found a role you could truly pour yourself into — and you're looking for the one that finally fits.



If you read all of this and thought "finally, this is the role I've been looking for" — apply: 
/careers/executive-assistant

title: Data Engineer (Financial Automation & Dashboards)
description:
TL;DR

The CFO Group is a fractional CFO firm serving founders with $5M to $100M in revenue. What we actually sell is visibility: a rolling 13-week cash forecast, a live dashboard the founder checks instead of ignores, and a real financial model behind every major decision.



Producing that today depends on people moving data by hand. Every week someone exports files from a client's accounting system, CRM, payroll platform, and bank, normalizes formats that never agree, reconciles the numbers, and rebuilds the reporting. We are hiring a data engineer to replace that with pipelines, and then turn the whole thing into a stack we can deploy to every client we take on.



You would be our first technical hire. The data infrastructure you build is the product.



Compensation: $5,000/month base plus up to $1,500/month performance bonus ($6,500/month on target). Full-time, fully remote. Eight hours a day, with only a two-hour required overlap: 8:00am to 10:00am US Eastern. You schedule the rest.



Why this role exists

Our clients do not have a numbers problem. They have a visibility problem. They are growing, profitable on paper, and still chasing payroll, because revenue is not cash and no one has built them a system that shows the difference before it hurts. Our whole value proposition is closing that gap: showing a founder where their cash is actually going, what their next hire truly costs, and which parts of the business make money.



The obstacle is that almost everything required to produce that visibility is manual data work. A finance person logs into five systems, pulls five extracts that disagree with each other, cleans them in Excel, reconciles them against the bank, and rebuilds a report. It is slow, it is fragile, and it scales only by hiring more people to do more of it. It also means the numbers often land days after the founder needed them, which is precisely the problem we are supposed to be solving.



That work is now code's job. Extraction, normalization, reconciliation, validation, exception flagging, and increasingly the first draft of the variance narrative itself. Automate that layer and our CFOs spend their hours on judgment instead of data janitorial work. Our domain is cfogroup.ai for a reason, and we would like the product to catch up to the domain.



We have proven the model once. For an insurance services client whose data was spread across a CRM, an accounting system, a contractor payroll platform, and monthly commission statements from several carriers, we built a live executive dashboard covering revenue, unit economics, cost of sales, gross profit, and cash. Their CEO and board use it. It works.



But it is still hand-fed every week, and rebuilding it from scratch for every new client is not a business. Your job is to fix both halves: automate the pipeline, then make it repeatable.



What you will do

Build the ingestion layer. Scheduled pipelines that pull data out of client accounting systems, CRMs, payroll platforms, banks, and vendor portals. Some sources have clean APIs. Many have nothing, and will require parsing
ed PDFs and Excel files, or scripted browser automation against a portal that was clearly built in 2009. You will d
 the right approach per source and build it.



Model the data. Every source names things differently and none of them agree. You will design a normalized data model that becomes the single source of truth for a client, with all the vendor-specific ugliness absorbed into code rather than living in a person's head.



Make reconciliation automatic. The numbers have to tie. Transaction data to statements, statements to bank deposits, payroll to the P&L. You will build validation and reconciliation into the pipeline so breaks surface immediately, instead of surfacing in front of a founder or a board.



Serve the reporting layer. The 13-week cash forecast, the hiring model, the margin-by-segment view, the executive dashboard. These are what clients pay us for. You will make them live, accurate, and self-updating rather than a spreadsheet someone refreshes on a Sunday night. This means owning the presentation layer too, so you need to be comfortable in HTML and JavaScript, not only in the pipeline behind it.



Productize the stack. This is the part that matters most. The goal is not one bespoke dashboard. It is a platform we can point at a new client and stand up in days, using connectors we already built and a reporting layer that gets configured rather than rewritten. You make the second, fifth, and twentieth deployment dramatically cheaper than the first.



Use AI as a real tool, not a demo. We use AI coding assistants and agentic tools every day and expect you to. A genuine part of this job is finding where an LLM does in seconds what a person does in an hour: classifying transactions, extracting structure from unstructured documents, explaining variances, summarizing exceptions. We want someone already fluent with these tools and opinionated about where they belong in a system that must produce correct numbers, and where they absolutely do not.



Talk to clients. Not constantly, but you will join calls to scope out a client's systems, learn what their data actually means, and demo what you have built. You need to hold a conversation with a non-technical founder or controller without condescending or disappearing into jargon.



What we are looking for



Must have:

3+ years building production data pipelines in Python. Real ETL: extraction, transformation, scheduling, orchestration, error handling, the parts that are not glamorous.



Strong SQL and sound instincts for data modeling. You can look at four inconsistent source systems and design the schema that reconciles them.



Experience with genuinely hostile data sources: undocumented APIs, CSV and Excel exports, PDF parsing, web scraping, and browser automation when there is no other way in. This is most of the job, so tell us about the worst one you have beaten.



Enough front-end capability (HTML, JavaScript, a modern framework) to build and maintain the dashboard, not only the pipeline feeding it. You do not need to be a designer. You do need to ship a working interface.



Demonstrated fluency with AI coding tools and LLM APIs. We will ask what you have actually built with them.



Obsessive numerical accuracy. In finance, a pipeline that is 99% correct is a pipeline that is wrong, and the person who finds out is a founder in a board meeting.



Clear written and spoken English, and the judgment to be trusted on a client call.



Nice to have:

Exposure to accounting or finance: general ledgers, P&Ls, reconciliations, cash forecasting. You do not need to be an accountant, but a balance sheet should not scare you.

Cloud deployment, job orchestration and scheduling, disciplined version control.

Experience building internal tools for non-technical users who will never read your documentation.

A track record of automating something nobody asked you to automate.



Please note: this is not a QA or test automation role, and it is not an RPA role. "Automation" here means automated data pipelines and reporting, not Selenium or UiPath.



Who this is not for: someone who needs a fully specified ticket before they can start. Problems arrive here as "these two numbers do not match and nobody knows why." You have to run that down yourself, and you have to care that it is wrong.



Who you would be working with

The CFO Group was founded by Joe Isaac, who audited at Ernst & Young, spent a decade at Amazon including leading FP&A for its $250B International Retail segment, and served as a strategic finance partner on the Amazon and Apple retail collaboration. Our clients are founders in construction, contracting, retail, restaurants, health and fitness, and insurance. You would report directly to Joe.



This is the first technical hire at a firm betting its growth on automation. There is no legacy stack to inherit and no committee to route decisions through. If you build the right thing, it ships.



Compensation and logistics

Base salary: $5,000 USD per month.

Performance bonus: up to $1,500 USD per month, for $6,500 per month on target.



How the bonus actually works: it is tied to delivery milestones you control, not to company revenue. We set the targets together at the start of each quarter and write them down. Things like getting a client's data sources fully automated, cutting deployment time for the next client, or eliminating a recurring manual process entirely. If you hit what we agreed, you get paid. 



Type: Full-time, fully remote.

Hours: Eight hours a day. The only fixed requirement is that you are online and available from 8:00am to 10:00am US Eastern, which is 8:00pm to 10:00pm in Manila (9:00pm to 11:00pm during the US winter, since the Philippines does not observe daylight saving). The other six hours are yours to schedule, along with your breaks. This is not a graveyard shift and we are not asking you to work one.



Benefits: Medical



Data handling: you will work with confidential client financial data and are expected to treat it accordingly.



How to apply

Send a short note covering:

1) A manual process you automated. What was it, what did you build, and what happened to the hours it used to consume?

2) The worst data source you have ever had to integrate, and how you finally got the data out of it.

3) One thing you have built using an AI coding assistant or an LLM API.



Please skip the generic cover letter. Three specific paragraphs beat a page of adjectives, and we will read them.

description:
Typical Responsibilities

Verify patient insurance eligibility and behavioral health benefits.

Post insurance and patient payments.

Correct and resubmit denied claims.

Appeal claim denials.

Verify copays, deductibles, and coinsurance.

Follow up on unpaid claims.

Reconcile accounts receivable (A/R).

Ensure documentation supports billed CPT and ICD-10 codes.

Monitor payer policy changes.

Common Mental Health CPT Codes



Psychiatry



90791 – Psychiatric diagnostic evaluation

90792 – Psychiatric diagnostic evaluation with medical services

99202–99215 – Office/outpatient E/M visits

90833 – Psychotherapy, 30 minutes with E/M (16–37 minutes)

90836 – Psychotherapy, 45 minutes with E/M (38–52 minutes)

90838 – Psychotherapy, 60 minutes with E/M (53+ minutes)



Psychotherapy



90832 – 30 minutes

90834 – 45 minutes

90837 – 60 minutes



Other



90846/90847 – Family psychotherapy

90853 – Group psychotherapy

ICD-10 Codes Frequently Used

F90.2 – ADHD

F41.1 – Generalized anxiety disorder

F33.1 – Major depressive disorder, recurrent, moderate

F31.9 – Bipolar disorder

F42.9 – Obsessive-compulsive disorder

F43.23 – Adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressed mood

F84.0 – Autism spectrum disorder

Behavioral Health Billing Knowledge



A qualified mental health biller should understand:



Telehealth billing requirements (including appropriate modifiers and place of service).

Documentation requirements for E/M and psychotherapy.

Time-based psychotherapy coding.

Add-on code 90833 with E/M services.

Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer policies.

Coordination of benefits.

Prior authorization requirements for behavioral health services.

Skills to Look For

Experience with psychiatric or behavioral health practices.

Knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding.

Familiarity with EHR/PM systems such as AdvancedMD, Kareo/Tebra, Athenahealth, SimplePractice, or Valant.

Strong denial management and appeals experience.

Understanding of HIPAA and payer compliance.

Certifications (Preferred)

Certified Professional Biller (CPB) – AAPC

Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) – AHIMA

Certified Professional Coder (CPC) – AAPC

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
# Operations Coordinator — Dispatch & CRM



**Location:** Remote (Philippines-based)

**Schedule:** Full-time, U.S. business hours

**Type:** Work from home



---



## Position Summary



The Operations Coordinator is responsible for managing the full lifecycle of a service job — from the 
nt a request comes in to the 
nt the invoice is closed and paid. This is a generalist operations role that combines dispatch, customer service, CRM administration, billing, and vendor management. The role sits at the center of daily operations and works alongside automated and AI-assisted systems.



This is a high-volume, fast-paced position. The right person is organized, calm under pressure, and comfortable owning a job from start to finish without being told what to do next.



---



## Core Responsibilities



### Dispatch & Job Management

- Receive inbound service requests via phone, web forms, and CRM intake

- Gather accurate job details: location, vehicle type, service needed, urgency

- Identify and assign the appropriate service provider based on location, capability, and availability

- Coordinate with providers to confirm acceptance, dispatch, and estimated arrival

- Track jobs in progress and provide status updates to customers

- Escalate delays, complications, or provider no-shows immediately

- Manage multiple active jobs simultaneously without losing track of any of them



### Phone & Customer Service

- Answer inbound calls professionally and quickly

- Communicate clearly with drivers, fleet managers, and service providers

- De-escalate frustrated customers — many callers are stranded and stressed

- Make outbound follow-up calls to customers and providers as needed

- Maintain a courteous, competent tone in every interaction



### CRM Administration

- Create, update, and maintain job records in the CRM

- Perform accurate data entry across customers, jobs, providers, and payments

- Keep records clean, complete, and current — no missing fields, no stale data

- Attach documentation, photos, and notes to the correct records

- Run basic reports and pull information on request



### Billing & Payment Processing

- Verify that work was completed as ordered before closing a job

- Generate and issue invoices accurately

- Process customer payments

- Follow up on outstanding and unpaid invoices

- Reconcile discrepancies between quoted, performed, and billed amounts

- Close out completed jobs cleanly in the system



### Vendor & Network Management

- Onboard new service providers into the network

- Collect and verify required provider documentation

- Enter and maintain provider profiles, service areas, capabilities, and rates

- Serve as a point of contact for providers with questions or issues

- Help identify and recruit providers in areas where coverage is thin



### Working with AI Systems

- Work alongside AI agents that handle portions of intake, communication, and administrative workflow

- Review, correct, and complete work handed off from automated systems

- Escalate anything the AI cannot resolve

- Flag errors, gaps, or bad outputs so systems can be improved



### General Support

- Support business growth initiatives as needed

- Take on new responsibilities as the operation scales

- Assist across multiple business divisions depending on daily need



---



## Required Qualifications



- **Excellent spoken and written English** — clear, neutral accent; you will be on the phone with U.S. customers all day

- Strong computer literacy and the ability to learn new software quickly

- Experience working in a CRM, ticketing system, or similar platform

- High attention to detail — billing and dispatch records must be accurate

- Ability to multitask and prioritize under pressure

- Reliable, self-directed, and accountable without close supervision

- Professional phone presence

- Reliable high-speed internet connection

- Quiet, dedicated work-from-home workspace

- Computer/laptop capable of running web-based software and handling calls

- Availability to work U.S. business hours (including possible weekend or after-hours shifts)



---



## Preferred Qualifications



- Prior experience in dispatch, logistics, trucking, roadside assistance, towing, or fleet services

- BPO, call center, or U.S.-facing customer service experience

- Experience with invoicing, billing, or accounts receivable

- Familiarity with U.S. geography — states, cities, and highways

- Experience working with AI tools or automated workflows

- Vendor management or supplier onboarding experience



---



## Key Competencies



| Competency | What It Looks Like |

|---|---|

| **Urgency** | You understand that a stranded driver is losing money every minute. You move fast. |

| **Ownership** | You take a job from intake to closed invoice without dropping it. |

| **Accuracy** | Your data entry is clean. Your invoices are right the first time. |

| **Composure** | Angry customer, missing provider, three jobs at once — you stay level. |

| **Communication** | Customers, providers, and teammates always know where things stand. |

| **Adaptability** | Processes change, tools change, priorities change. You adjust. |



---



## Performance Expectations (First 90 Days)



- **Days 1–30:** Learn the CRM, the service categories, and the dispatch workflow. Handle inbound calls with support. Begin entering and updating job records independently.

- **Days 31–60:** Independently dispatch and manage jobs end to end. Begin closing out invoices and processing payments. Assist with vendor onboarding.

- **Days 61–90:** Operate at full capacity across dispatch, CRM, billing, and vendor management. Handle escalations. Identify process gaps and suggest improvements.



---



## Growth Path



This role is the foundation of the operations organization. Coordinators who master dispatch, the CRM, and the billing cycle are the natural candidates for **Senior Coordinator**, **Team Lead**, and **Operations Manager** positions as the team scales. We promote from within.



---



## Compensation



Competitive salary based on experience, paid on a consistent schedule. Performance-based increases available. [Insert rate range.]



---



## To Apply



Submit your resume along with a brief note describing your relevant experience. Qualified candidates will be contacted for a phone or video interview to assess English communication and problem-solving ability.

title: Operations & Finance Specialist for Ad Agency (Xero Experience Required)
description:
Company: Kingfisher Ads, a US-based advertising agency specializing in Google and Meta ads for the golf industry



About us



We run paid advertising for golf brands. Small team, direct communication, no corporate fluff. We move fast and we want to automate everything worth automating.



Why this role is different



Most ops roles are about doing the tasks. This one is about owning them and making them better.



You'd own the processes that keep the agency running: client onboarding, reporting workflows, hiring admin, our new creator program, and the monthly finances. We care as much about how you improve these processes as how well you run them.



We use AI a lot (Claude especially) and we're building more automation into how we work (Zapier, n8n). You won't be expected to build complex automations alone, that's a team effort, but you should be the person spotting what's worth automating, helping set it up, and handling the exceptions once it's running. If you're the type who asks "why are we still doing this by hand?", you'll do well here.



If you've worked at an ad agency before, you already know the work we're talking about: client reporting, onboarding, campaign admin, the monthly rhythm of it all. If you've improved or automated processes around any of that, especially reporting, you're exactly who we're looking for.



What you'd own



Operations (most of your time)



- Improving our recurring processes and helping automate the ones worth automating, client reporting workflows are a big one

- Building and running client onboarding checklists in ClickUp

- Screening job applicants against our criteria before they reach us

- Documenting SOPs across the agency

- Tracking software subscriptions and flagging waste

- Contractor payment admin as our freelance team grows



Content creator program (new, you'd help build it)



We're building a roster of golf content creators for client campaigns. Creators apply through our website, and you'd help run the program from the ground up:



- Screening inbound creator applications and keeping the creator database current (rates, availability, content styles, past performance)

- Managing creator relationships day to day: coordinating briefs, deadlines, and deliverables across campaigns

- Tracking creator payments alongside the rest of contractor payment admin



Lead generation support



- Building and cleaning prospect lists of golf brands and businesses that fit our ideal client profile

- Keeping the CRM organized and up to date

- Researching prospects before sales calls



Finance (smaller in hours, non-negotiable in skill)



This is the part that has to be done right every month, and it's why Xero experience is a hard requirement:



- Monthly bookkeeping and bank reconciliations in Xero

- Client billing prep: pulling ad spend from Google and Meta, calculating fees, staging invoices

- Completing our monthly cash flow tracking spreadsheet and recommending improvements to how we categorize and track

- Moving clients onto automated payments (ACH)

- A short monthly financial summary: revenue by client, spending trends, anything we should look at



Being "familiar with Xero" isn't enough for this role. We need someone who has owned the month-end process themselves, reconciliations done, everything coded, reports checked, and who stands behind their own numbers.



Requirements



- 2+ years of bookkeeping experience with Xero, including owning the month-end process. This is a hard requirement

- Experience working with US-based businesses

- Strong written English

- Detail-obsessed. Reconciliations that are almost right are wrong

- Comfortable learning new tools quickly

- Own computer, stable internet, and a backup plan for power or internet outages

- Available for a few hours of overlap with US Eastern time (most of the work is flexible)



Big bonuses



- Experience working at or with an advertising or marketing agency, especially on client reporting

- Direct experience managing or supporting ad campaigns (Google, Meta)

- Zapier or n8n experience

- ClickUp or similar PM tool experience

- Daily use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) in your work

- Experience working with influencers or content creators



Pay



Includes 13th month pay. Full time, long-term role. Salary as listed, paid monthly.



Hiring process



Shortlisted candidates will do a short video interview followed by a paid test task. We respect your time and won't ask for free work.



How to apply



Start your application with the word KINGFISHER so we know you read this post.



Then answer these three questions. Applications without answers to all three will not be considered:



1. Describe a repetitive task you automated in a previous role. What tool did you use and what was the result?

2. What's a common mistake you see in how small businesses track cash flow?

3. Walk us through your month-end process in Xero, step by step. What do you check before you consider the month done?



Include the types of US businesses you've done bookkeeping for, and mention any agency or ad management experience.
