title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Remote | Australian Creative Agency | Philippines Preferred



Ongoing retainer work with an established Creative Agency, specialising in social media content and performance marketing.



APPLICATION FORM: 



Hey there!



We're a creative agency that helps businesses tell their stories through photography, videography, social media, and Meta advertising. We've been around since 2017 and currently manage a growing retainer client base across B2B and service-based industries.



We're looking for a Senior Graphic Designer to join our team and take ownership of our visual design output — both the social media content we create for clients and the internal materials that represent our own brand.



Being able to adapt/enhance a client's existing brand is also important. Some clients come to us with excellent brand playbooks and assets, others have a font and a logo and then it's up to us to get creative with it. So someone who can develop the brand is important too.



If you're someone who takes real pride in clean, polished design work, can manage multiple brands without mixing them up, and can make a pitch deck look like it belongs in a boardroom — keep reading.



What You'll Actually Be Doing:



Client Social Media Design (the majority of your time):



- Designing organic carousels, static posts, video thumbnails, and story assets for our retainer clients across Instagram,
, and LinkedIn

- Similar to above, but rather than organic content, this would be performance creative used for ads. Think carousels, statics, stories etc that stop the scroll and incite action.

- Working within established brand guidelines for each client — you'll manage multiple brand identities simultaneously and uplift their branding where necessary. As mentioned, some clients don’t have a lot to work with initially, so we develop this for them.

- Receiving briefs through ClickUp and delivering designs for internal review before they go to the client

- Maintaining visual consistency across each client's content so their feed looks intentional, not random



Internal & Agency Design:



- Updating our own internal assets where need be. This could be our strategy documents, pitch decks and more.

- Creating and formatting strategy presentations and content plans for client delivery

- Designing internal templates, one-pagers, capability statements, and other brand collateral

- Producing social media content for Narrative Hub's own channels

- Refining the visual format of our monthly client reports



The Tools You'll Work With:



- Canva (Pro): Our preferred tool for day-to-day social media designs. Many clients have existing Canva templates that you'll build on and maintain. We're flexible on tools as long as the quality is there and revisions can be turned around quickly.

- Adobe Creative Suite: Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign for more complex work — pitch decks, detailed presentations, advanced graphics, and anything that needs precision layout. We need you to be genuinely proficient here, not just familiar.

- ClickUp: Where all briefs, feedback, time tracking, and task management lives. This is our central hub.

- Dropbox: File storage and sharing for all working files and final deliverables.

- We provide all software subscriptions (Adobe, Canva Pro, etc.), Dropbox storage, and ClickUp access. You provide your own hardware and a reliable internet connection.



What We're Looking For



Must-haves:



- 3+ years of professional graphic design experience, ideally in an agency or managing multiple brand accounts

- Strong portfolio showing social media design work — carousels, static posts, branded content

- Experience designing presentations and pitch decks to a high standard

- Proficient in both Canva and Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)

- Solid understanding of typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and brand application

- Detail-oriented — you notice when spacing is off, a colour is wrong, or a font doesn't match

- Clear written communication in English

- Comfortable with feedback and revisions — it's part of the process, not a personal critique



Good to have:



- Experience working with Australian businesses or in a similar time zone

- Familiarity with social media platform specs and best practices (image sizes, safe zones, etc.)

- Experience with B2B or service-based brands specifically



What You Won't Be Doing



Just to set expectations:



- No video editing (we have dedicated editors for that)

- No social media scheduling or community management

- No photography or videography

- No website design or development

- No Meta ad campaign management



You won't be expected to write copy, but you may need to take our briefs and alter them to suit the designs. 



Sometimes we may come to you with specific copy, other times we will have some key messages and you’ll have the ability to refine it or make it more concise to fit the assets you’re working on.



How We Work



- Social Media Manager/Coordinator: manages your day-to-day client work — they'll brief you, review your designs, and keep you aligned with content calendars

- The Social Media Coordinator will also work closely with you on content calendar alignment and design briefs.

- Occasionally the Managing Director may brief you on internal work, however this will mostly be the SMM/SMC’s responsibility.



Our process is straightforward:



- You receive a brief in ClickUp with all the details — client, content type, messaging, brand assets

- You design, tracking your time in ClickUp as you go

- Internal review (1 round) — Social Media Manager or Coordinator for client work, MD for internal work.

- Client approval (1 round) — managed by the Social Media Manager

- Final files exported and saved to Dropbox, ready for scheduling

- If a brief is unclear, we expect you to ask before you start — not after you've completed a draft.



The Details



Location: Remote — Philippines-based candidates preferred due to timezones.

Employment Type: Freelance, ongoing retainer based on set deliverables preferred. There may be agreed hourly projects outside of this from time to time. 



While our preference is the above to manage workload, we are also happy to work with skilled designers on an ad-hoc basis alongside our main designers.



Hours: You will have freedom to set your own hours, working times however there will be deadlines to adhere to.

Communication: ClickUp for tasks and feedback, ClickUp Chat for quick questions and check-ins



Start Date: Immediately.



Interested?



- If this sounds like a good fit, we'd love to hear from you. In your application, please share fill out the below form so we can assess your application:



APPLICATION FORM: 



Please be sure to include in the form:

- A link to your portfolio (or a few examples of your best social media design and presentation work)

- A brief overview of your experience — especially if you've worked in an agency or managed multiple brands

- Which tools you're most comfortable in (Canva, Adobe Suite, or both) and how you typically approach a design brief

- Any other information it asks for



Thank you and we wish you the best with your application!

title: DaVinci Resolve Video Editor and Cinematic Colorist
description:
Job Description

We are hiring a DaVinci Resolve Video Editor and Professional Colorist for an ongoing AI-generated TV series.



The main responsibility is to professionally color-grade footage and create a consistent cinematic look across every scene. Since the clips are generated separately, the lighting, exposure, colors, contrast, sharpness, and skin tones may not always match. You must know how to correct those differences and make the final episode feel like one polished production.



This is not a basic CapCut or social-media editing position. We are looking for someone who understands real cinematic color grading and can improve the overall visual quality of the tv series.



Main Responsibilities

Professionally color-correct and color-grade footage in DaVinci Resolve.

Match lighting, exposure, contrast, color, and skin tones between separate clips.

Use masking, tracking, stabilization, flicker reduction, noise reduction, sharpening, and other cleanup tools when needed.

Create reusable cinematic looks, node structures, PowerGrades, or LUTs for the series.

Keep Black skin tones and other complexions natural and accurate.

Assemble provided clips into complete scenes and episodes.

Smooth out rough, jumpy, or unnatural transitions.

Identify clips that cannot be repaired and need to be regenerated.

Export polished, high-quality final episodes.



What We Are Looking For

Strong experience using DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro.

Advanced color correction and color-grading skills.

Experience matching footage from different clips or cameras.

A good eye for cinematic lighting, skin tones, contrast, and visual consistency.

Ability to edit films, TV scenes, music videos, commercials, or other cinematic content.

Reliable communication and the ability to follow detailed feedback.



A computer that can smoothly edit and color-grade 4K footage in DaVinci Resolve.



To Apply

1. A short introduction.

3. At least one before-and-after color-grading example.

4. A screenshot of your computer specifications.

title: Shopify Store Virtual Assistant
description:
We are currently on the lookout for a VA to take over the day-to-day operations of our online e-Commerce Shopify store based in New Zealand. The candidate will be required to work 8am-5pm New Zealand time (NZ is 4hrs ahead of the Philippines).



We are looking for someone who is happy to work on an hourly rate - payments can be made weekly / monthly.



The VA will need to handle customer service (phone calls, e-mails and Live chat), upload new products to our website, with a little bit of social media management as well.



Our shop is a 100% drop-shipping business. We do not keep any stock - all our suppliers dispatch the products directly to our customers or the customers collect directly from our Suppliers' warehouses. Our products are construction products like reinforcing steel, temporary fencing, plasterboard, etc. Soon we will also be branching into garden sheds, greenhouses, pergolas and other home / backyard products.



We have lots of draft e-mails saved that the VA will be able to use to respond to customer enquiries.



To ensure we don't receive spam job applications + to ensure that you have read the entire job description and also that you are a detailed oriented person, please make sure you type the word "Success" as the very first word of your application.



Here is an outline of the typical daily activities and the skills we are looking for:



- High level of written and spoken English.

- Experience with using Shopify online e-Commerce platform (as part of the recruitment process we'll be asking you to create / upload a new product at our website so we can assess your skill level).

- Receive customer enquiries via phone calls, e-mail and online chat - ability to respond professionally and politely to customer enquiries.

- Get delivery quotes from our suppliers for these customer enquiries.

- Send quotes via e-mail to customers for pick-up and delivery orders.

- Coordinate with our suppliers to ensure products are delivered on time (if the order has a deadline), otherwise within 2-3 working days.

- Two weekly posts to our social media pages to advertise one of our products or share a customer review.

- Candidates who are familiar with Shopify e-Commerce platform will be highly preferred - daily tasks inside Shopify will include the following:

     * Orders which are placed online and paid via credit card need to be processed (get quote from Supplier and pay supplier).

     * For enquiries which are received via e-mail or the store's "Get a Quote" form - draft orders need to be generated manually inside Shopify.

     * Send draft invoices to customers for these manual orders so they can make payment via internet banking (we have an app that generates the invoices).

     * Upload new products to the store (including product descriptions and images - can be done via AI - training will be provided - it's pretty easy).

- Other tasks inside the business might include collecting customer reviews, maintaining a clean e-mail inbox (moving older e-mails inside folders), SEO, link-building, accounting/bookkeeping (training can be provided for the correct candidate).

- Working hours will be 8am to 5pm New Zealand time, Monday to Friday.



Feel free to get in touch if your experience and skills match our job description and let us know how soon you are able to start.

title: Section 8 & Lease Compliance Coordinator
description:
Harborview Property Management is a fast-growing residential property management and real estate acquisitions company in South Jersey. We own and manage a portfolio of ~200 scattered-site single-family rentals across 7 South Jersey counties (Salem, Cumberland, Gloucester, Camden, Atlantic, Ocean, Cape May), most under Section 8/HAP tenancy. We're building out our core team and looking for a detail-obsessed, deadline-driven Compliance Coordinator to own the paperwork and regulatory side of our operation.

This is a direct hire position — you'll work for us, not a staffing agency — with real ownership over every compliance deadline across our portfolio. It's a stable, long-term full-time role with a growing company, with a performance review and compensation discussion at 60 days.

You'll be responsible for tracking every PHA repair-cure notice and inspection failure across all 7 counties and driving it to resolution before the deadline, coordinating with our maintenance team on repair proof submissions, scheduling HQS/REAC inspections, handling annual recertifications and HAP paperwork, and preparing Section 8 move-in packets. You'll also prepare and manage lease renewals, coordinate township Certificate of Occupancy processes, track municipal rental license renewals and NJ state landlord registrations, and stay on top of code enforcement violations before fines apply. You'll coordinate directly with tenants to schedule inspection access, and maintain a running tracker of every open compliance item so nothing slips through the cracks.

We need someone with excellent written and spoken English, strong organizational skills to juggle dozens of deadlines across multiple counties and agencies at once, and comfort working independently in AppFolio (or willingness to learn quickly). Prior experience with Section 8/HAP, property management, or lease administration is a strong plus, as is experience with NJ housing authorities, municipal C/O or code enforcement processes, a paralegal/legal admin background, or other property management software (Buildium, Yardi). You'll need a reliable internet connection, a dedicated home office setup, and availability during U.S. Eastern business hours.

Pay: $9/hour USD (~$1,560/month, 40 hrs/week)

To apply, please include:



A brief description of your relevant experience — property management, Section 8/HAP, leasing, or compliance-related work, and for how long

Your available start date

Confirmation you can work U.S. Eastern business hours full-time

title: Land Acquisitions Wholesale Real Estate FL
description:
Company Description:



We are a forward-thinking real estate investment firm based in Florida, USA. With a proven track record in residential properties, we are aggressively expanding our operations into the lucrative niche of land investing. We are looking for a highly experienced and autonomous Land Specialist to become the cornerstone of our land division.



Job Summary:



This is a senior-level opportunity for a VA who is a master of the land investment lifecycle. We are not looking for a general real estate assistant; we need an expert who lives and breathes land. You will be the engine room of our Florida land operations, responsible for everything from identifying undervalued parcels to structuring profitable seller financing deals that generate long-term cashflow. Your deep expertise in due diligence and creating notes will be critical to our success.



Required Tech Stack (Must Have Experience):




 (or sms campaign experience): Daily management of SMS campaigns.

PropStream & Zillow: Rapid market research and running comps.

County GIS Maps: Navigating local county sites for zoning, parcel boundaries, and utility checks.



Bonus Tech Stack (Highly Preferred, but will train):



BuyerBridge.ai: Finding builders and managing buyer lists.

Id.Land: Property mapping and evaluation.

Resimpli CRM: Lead and data management.

Land Insights: For advanced property data and evaluation.


: For rapid due diligence and parcel checks.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Deal Flow & Acquisitions:



* Lead Generation: Implement and manage marketing campaigns to generate a consistent flow of motivated land sellers.

* Lead Management: Immediately respond to and professionally handle incoming seller leads on SmarterContact. Filter for motivation and negotiate pricing.

* Land Analysis & Comping: Accurately determine the market value of raw land in Florida by rapidly analyzing comparable sales and market data.

* In-Depth Due Diligence: Conduct comprehensive due diligence on every potential property using GIS and our tech stack, including:

* Verifying local Florida zoning regulations and land use restrictions.

* Confirming legal and physical access (easements, road frontage).

* Investigating utility availability (water, sewer/septic, electricity).

* Checking for wetlands, flood zones, topography issues, and other potential restrictions.

* Acquisitions: Present offers and negotiate purchase agreements with American sellers, with a strong focus on acquiring properties using seller financing.



2. Seller Financing & Dispositions:



* Structure Creative Deals: Architect and structure seller financing (note) terms for both buying land from original owners and selling it to end buyers.

* Pitch Seller Financing: Expertly explain the benefits of seller financing to property owners to get more deals accepted over cash offers.

* Dispositions & Buyer Relations: Market our land inventory for sale, primarily on terms, to generate cash flow and create valuable paper assets (notes). Utilize BuyerBridge.ai (if familiar) to connect with builders and buyers.

* Transaction Coordination: Prepare and coordinate the necessary documents to successfully close on the acquisition and disposition of properties.



Qualifications and Experience:



Experience: Minimum 2+ years of direct, hands-on experience as a VA specifically in the US LAND INVESTING niche. (This is a strict, non-negotiable requirement).



Creative Finance Expertise: Demonstrable expertise in SELLER FINANCING. You must have extensive experience creating, pitching, and structuring notes for both the acquisition and disposition of land.



Mastery of Due Diligence: You must know exactly what to look for and what questions to ask to determine a property's true value and usability.



Market Knowledge: Familiarity with Florida markets and county zoning sites is highly preferred. Experience with RV Parks or Manufactured Homes is a huge plus.



Communication: Fluent English (Speaking and Writing). Exceptional negotiation skills; you must be confident and persuasive when building rapport on the phone.



Autonomy: Highly organized, systems-oriented, and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously with zero hand-holding.



Bonus: Experience with selling performing notes to third-party note buyers.



What We Offer:



Premium Compensation: We offer a highly competitive base salary plus a significant performance-based bonus for every profitable deal you manage. Your income is directly tied to the value you create.



Leadership Role: You won't be just another VA; you will be a key leader in building our land business from the ground up.



Autonomy & Trust: We are looking for an expert we can trust to run the process. You will have the autonomy to make decisions and implement your strategies.



Long-Term Stability & Growth: This is a long-term position with a company that is committed to growing and investing in its team.



How to Apply:



If you are a true Land Investing Specialist who meets these demanding qualifications, we want to talk to you. Do not send a generic cover letter. Please submit your application with a customized cover letter that explicitly answers the following questions:



Describe your land due diligence process. What are the top 5 most critical things you look for before recommending the purchase of a rural, vacant land parcel?



Explain, as if you were speaking to a property owner over the phone, the benefits for them to sell their land to us using seller financing instead of waiting for a full cash offer.



How many years of experience do you have in Land acquisitions and dispositions?



Do you have experience with SmarterContact or Launch Control?



List one specific Florida county or city you have worked in previously.



Have you done any creative financing or seller financing deals? 



Do you have any experience with subdividing land or doing lot splits?



Do you also have experience with houses (not just land)? 



We have both weekly hours and weekend hours available. Please specify which hours interest you the most.



Applications that do not include thoughtful answers to these 5 questions will be immediately disqualified. This is your chance to prove your expertise. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: YouTube Video Editor & Content Strategist for Real Estate Brand
description:
We are looking for a talented YouTube video editor and content strategist to help grow a Toronto-based real estate brand across YouTube, TikTok and Instagram.



This is not just a video editing position. I am looking for someone who can assist with the full content creation process—from researching video ideas to helping develop scripts, editing the content and uploading it to our channels.



We currently have approximately 2,000 YouTube subscribers and 4,500 TikTok followers. Our Instagram account is still very small, with around 45 followers, and one of our goals is to build that platform as well.



Your Responsibilities



You will help with all three phases of our content creation process.



1. Research and Content Planning

-Research trending real estate and housing-related videos on YouTube

-Find successful video topics from other cities, countries and real estate markets that could be adapted for the Toronto market

-Study competitors and identify topics, titles and formats that are performing well

-Help brainstorm engaging YouTube titles, hooks and thumbnail concepts

-Use AI tools to help with research, scriptwriting and content development

-Help turn rough ideas, notes and market data into organized video concepts



2. Long-Form YouTube Video Editing



You will edit approximately three YouTube videos per week.



The videos will typically focus on:



Housing market updates

Real estate news



Editing responsibilities may include:



-Removing pauses, mistakes and unnecessary sections

-Keeping the pacing engaging and conversational

-Adding relevant B-roll

-Adding headlines, captions and on-screen text

-Highlighting graphs, charts and statistics

-Displaying newspaper articles or screenshots that I provide

-Zooming in on important information

-Creating simple visual explanations that make the videos easier to understand

-Helping maintain viewer attention throughout the video



I do not want videos that feel over-edited or distracting. The editing should support the story, improve retention and make complicated real estate topics easier to follow.



3. Short-Form Content and Uploading



After editing each YouTube video, you will also:



-Turn the long-form video into a long-form Reel, TikTok 

-Identify the strongest 
nts from the video

-Add engaging on-screen text

-Format the content correctly for vertical platforms

-Upload completed videos to TikTok and Instagram

-Add titles, descriptions, hashtags and other publishing details

-Help keep the content calendar organized



Ideal Candidate



The ideal person will have:



-Strong video editing experience

-A reliable, high-performance computer capable of editing long-form video

-Experience using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar editing software

-Strong knowledge of YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels and short-form content

-A good understanding of storytelling, pacing and audience retention

-Experience researching trending content and successful video topics

-The ability to use AI tools for research, brainstorming and scriptwriting

-Strong English comprehension

-Good attention to detail

-The ability to work independently and meet weekly deadlines

-A proven track record of editing content that performed well online



Experience editing real estate, business, educational or documentary-style content would be an advantage, but it is not mandatory.



Work Schedule



I am flexible regarding when you complete the work. I am more focused on quality, communication and meeting deadlines than requiring you to work specific hours.



The expected workload will include approximately three long-form YouTube videos per week, 3 long-form reels per week from the same video and uploading content to our social media channels.



This has the potential to become a long-term position for the right person.



About Me



I run a real estate team in Toronto, Canada. Our content is designed to educate home buyers and sellers while building trust with people who may eventually need help with real estate.



I am easygoing, open to new ideas and want this role to be enjoyable for both parties. I am looking for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys being creative and wants to help build something over the long term.



You will have room to contribute ideas and help shape the direction of the content rather than simply being given editing instructions.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



-A brief explanation of your video editing experience

-The editing software you currently use

-Details about your computer and editing setup

-Your experience with YouTube, TikTok and Instagram

-Examples of short-form videos, Reels or TikToks you have edited

Please do not send only a generic application. Explain why you believe you would be a good fit for this specific position.



At the beginning of your application, include the words “Toronto YouTube” so I know you carefully read the entire job description.

What you’ll be responsible for:

, Threads, and LinkedIn

 direction together

• You use AI tools to move faster BUT your own judgment to d
 what’s good

• A real seat at the table as your ideas direct the strategy

• Direct access to me, fast decisions, no bureaucracy

• Pay that grows with your impact, plus performance bonuses

• A long-term role. I want to find the right person once and invest in her

1. A short intro: who you’ve supported before, and the single result you’re most proud of, with the actual number and the context around it (leads per month, cost per lead, calls booked, revenue, whatever fits)

title: Operations & Executive Assistant (Remote – Long-Term)
description:
This is not a typical assistant role.



We are building a company where AI handles the routine work, and our people handle the thinking. If you are someone who already works that way — or wants to — this role was built for you.



We are looking for an Operations & Executive Assistant who is as comfortable setting up an AI workflow as they are managing a client invoice or reconciling a vendor bill. Someone who sees a repetitive task and immediately thinks "how do I automate this" rather than "I'll just do it manually every time."



If that is how your mind works, keep reading.



~~~~~~~~~~

~About Us~

We are a Canadian Managed IT Services company supporting 225 devices across 15 business clients. We are growing fast and hiring an Operations, Accounting & Executive Assistant to help remove bottlenecks so our founder can focus on scaling the business from 225 to 500+ endpoints.



The person in this role will not just help us operate — they will help us build systems that let us scale without adding headcount at every step.



~~~~~~~~~~

~Your Mission~

Keep our operations and customers organized, our accounting accurate, our clients well-billed, and our vendor invoices reconciled — while continuously finding smarter, AI-powered ways to get more done with less manual effort.



~~~~~~~~~~

~Work Schedule~

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Flexible schedule with a minimum 4-hour overlap with Pacific Time (Canada)

- You choose your remaining hours within reason



~~~~~~~~~~

~Compensation~

- CAD $600 – $1,200/month depending on experience

- Paid bi-weekly

- End-of-year performance bonus tied to company growth and your contribution to it — the more you help the business grow, the more you share in that success

- Long-term role with a clear path to increased responsibility and pay



~~~~~~~~~~

~Primary Responsibilities~



~Founder Support~

- Manage and organize
 inbox

- Respond to simple client inquiries

- Schedule meetings and follow-ups

- Track action items and tasks

- Prepare weekly operations summaries



~Client Operations~

- Track client users, devices, and licenses for invoicing

- Maintain client records and documentation

- Assist with quoting clients, sourcing prices, Liason with founder and build quote, move quote to order and invoice appropriately and assist on collecting payment



~~~~~~~~~~

~Accounting & Billing — **Core Part of the Role**~

You will own the billing cycle end to end and be the first line of review on all financial activity.  As we have about 15 customers this is important work, yet not the time spent task.  

**2-4 years experience is required.**



~Invoicing & Billing~

- Review Microsoft 365 license counts via Ingram Micro before each billing cycle to ensure every license is accounted for and billed correctly to the right client

- Cross-reference Ingram Micro invoices for hardware and software purchases — confirm what was ordered, delivered, and billed to the client matches

- Prepare accurate client invoices in Wave Accounting

- Review invoice counts and amounts before invoices go out — catch errors before clients see them

- Send client statements and follow up on overdue invoices professionally



~Payments & Deposits~

- Process incoming electronic payments and match them to open client invoices in Wave Accounting

- When the owner deposits a cheque by bank scan, a photo of the cheque will be uploaded to SharePoint — you will be notified and are responsible for marking the deposit against the correct invoice in Wave

- Track all deposits and flag any discrepancies



~Credit Card & Expense Review~

- Regularly review company credit card statements

- Match charges to client accounts or internal cost categories

- Flag any unrecognized or suspicious charges as potential fraud

- Initiate disputes through the appropriate channel when required



~Accounting Inbox — 

- Monitor and manage the accounting inbox

- Respond to client billing questions and payment inquiries professionally

- Process vendor invoices received by

- Confirm payment receipts and send acknowledgements

- Escalate anything requiring owner decision



~~~~~~~~~~

~Operations Monitoring~

- Monitor support tickets in our Kaseya software stack

- Flag unresolved issues

- Ensure documentation is kept up to date



~~~~~~~~~~

~Growth Support~

- Maintain prospect quotes and follow up

- Help organize proposals

- Help hire and work with Marketing Manager



~~~~~~~~~~

~AI & Automation — Central to This Role~

We do not expect you to do everything manually. We expect you to figure out what AI can do, set it up, manage the output, and escalate only what needs a human decision.



- Identify repetitive tasks and build AI workflows to handle them

- Manage and review AI-generated outputs before they reach clients or the founder

- Continuously look for ways to do more with less manual effort

- Help the company build systems that scale without adding headcount



The goal is not for you to work harder. It is for you to work smarter — and help the whole company do the same.



Over time, your role will shift from doing the work to managing the systems that do the work. That is the direction we are heading, and we want someone who is excited about that future — not threatened by it.



~~~~~~~~~~

~Required Skills~

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Bookkeeping or invoicing experience — you must be comfortable working with numbers and financial records

- Experience with AI tools and automation



~~~~~~~~~~

~Helpful Experience~

- Wave Accounting or similar bookkeeping software

- Microsoft 365 and SharePoint

- PSA or ticketing systems (e.g. Kaseya)

- Distributor or vendor invoice reconciliation

- AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar)



~~~~~~~~~~

~Tools We Use~

- Wave Accounting

- Ingram Micro distributor portal

- Kaseya software stack

- Microsoft 365 and SharePoint

- PSA / ticketing systems

- Spreadsheets and documentation tools

- AI tools — and we are always adding more



~~~~~~~~~~

~Personality We Are Looking For~

- Extremely organized

- Detail-focused — billing errors cost us money and client trust

- Proactive problem solver — you fix things before being asked

- Calm and dependable

- Trustworthy with financial information

- Genuinely excited about building better systems

- You see AI as a tool that makes you more powerful, not a threat to your job

- Reliable, consistent, and self-managed



~~~~~~~~~~

~Weekly Report You Will Own~

- Invoices sent

- Payments received and deposits processed

- Overdue invoices and follow-up status

- Credit card review status and any flagged charges

- Operational issues needing attention

- Priorities for the coming week



~~~~~~~~~~

~Long-Term Opportunity~

As AI takes over more of the routine work, this role grows with it. Your path could lead to:



- Operations Manager

- Finance Coordinator

- Automation & Process Manager



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us for years, not months — and who wants to be part of building something, not just maintaining it.



~~~~~~~~~~

~How to Apply~

To be considered, your application must include all four of the following:



1. Your experience with operations, admin, or bookkeeping — be specific about what you did

2. The tools you have used — software, platforms, and AI tools

3. A specific example of how you have used AI to save time or improve a process

4. An example of a time you caught a billing or financial error before it became a problem



~Bonus Task — complete this to stand out:~

Review the following client billing summary:



Client A | 12 devices | 10 licenses billed | 12 on record | Oct 1 | Unpaid | 45 days overdue

Client B | 8 devices | 8 licenses billed | 8 on record | Oct 15 | Paid

Client C | 22 devices | 22 licenses billed | 25 on record | Sept 15 | Unpaid | 60 days overdue

Client D | 5 devices | 5 licenses billed | 5 on record | Oct 20 | Paid

Client E | 17 devices | 20 licenses billed | 17 on record | Oct 1 | Unpaid | 45 days overdue



Answer these three questions:



1. Which clients have a billing discrepancy and what is the issue with each?

2. Which clients need immediate payment follow-up and why?

3. How would you use an AI tool to automate the overdue invoice follow-up process so you are managing it rather than writing each
 manually? Describe your approach in 2-3 sentences.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

title: Ecommerce Growth Manager — DTC Supplements Brand (Meta Ads + Klaviyo)
description:
Read this first: we are only hiring someone who has already done this successfully. You have personally scaled — or been a key driver in scaling — a DTC brand to 7 figures ($1M+/year), ideally in supplements or wellness. You have the numbers, the account walkthroughs, and the founder references to prove it. If you haven’t had a big win yet, please don’t apply — this posting is not a place to get your first one.



We are launching a US direct-to-consumer supplements brand (Shopify-first, with Amazon as a secondary channel) and are hiring ONE senior person to own the entire brand’s growth — acquisition, retention, Amazon, channel strategy, and the team. You will run this brand like a general manager who owns the P&L. 



At our current stage (launch), that means hands-on execution too — especially Meta ads, which is our primary acquisition channel and a hard requirement. As the brand scales, you will hire and manage your own team (media buyer, CS, specialists) under you and graduate into a pure management role.



This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior media buyer role. You will make strategic decisions, not just execute someone else’s plan.



What you will own: - Overall growth strategy and channel mix — you d
 where our money and effort go, and you defend those decisions with numbers - Meta ads strategy and hands-on campaign management - Landing page and funnel strategy — offers, advertorials, CRO testing - Klaviyo
/SMS — building all core flows and campaigns from scratch - Unit economics — you will track new-customer CAC, contribution margin per order, and subscription take rate, and report them to the founder weekly - Coordinating our creative strategist and video editor (already hired — you brief them, they produce) - Basic Amazon listing hygiene to capture spillover demand - Recommending and managing any additional freelancers we need



Non-negotiable requirements: - 3+ years running Meta ads for DTC brands with at least 1 year on a SUPPLEMENT, health, or wellness brand. You must know how to write and structure ads that pass Meta’s health-claims review. - Hands-on Klaviyo experience (flows, not just campaigns) - You can explain the difference between blended CAC and new-customer CAC, and why it matters - Experience with a brand that reached at least $50K/month in revenue, where you can explain exactly what YOU did to contribute. Strong preference for candidates who worked on a brand that scaled to 7 figures/year ($1M+). - You have a bench of proven freelancers (designers, devs, Amazon specialists) you’ve worked with before and can bring in as needed - Fluent written English; comfortable on weekly video calls with the founder - Full-time, no other clients



How we work: launch fast, test fast. We’d rather run many quick tests and kill losers early than polish one big campaign. If you need everything perfect before shipping, this isn’t the right role.



Nice to have: advertorial/quiz funnel experience, subscription app experience (Recharge/Stay/Skio), Amazon Seller Central familiarity, experience hiring/managing freelancers.



How to apply (read carefully — applications that skip this are deleted): Start your application with the word “CREATINE” so we know you read this. 



Then: 



1. Record a 2–3 minute Loom video (camera on) answering: name a supplement or wellness brand you worked on, your role, the monthly ad spend, the AOV, the new-customer CAC, and the gross margin. Paste the Loom link at the top of your application. 

2. In writing: describe one campaign or test YOU d
 to run. What was the number before and after? 

3. In writing: what claim language has gotten your ads rejected by Meta, and how did you rewrite it to get approved? 

4. In writing: tell us about a product or campaign you could NOT make work, and what you concluded from it. 

5. In writing: if we handed you a brand-new supplement brand today, how would you d
 the channel mix for the first 6 months? Be specific about why. 

6. Your expected monthly salary and earliest start date.



Applications without a Loom link will not be reviewed.

title: Platform & Integration Engineer (Contract, Immediate Start)
description:
A leading Australian beauty brand — multi-location, 200+ staff, scaling fast.



ABOUT THE ROLE



Our systems haven't kept up — the business runs on thousands of spreadsheets and disconnected tools. We've finished the thinking (full build spec, process playbook, every platform decision documented and locked). We need one pragmatic engineer to build it.



WHAT YOU'LL BUILD



One operations app ("the Hub") on Base44 — 8 modules on one database:

- Events (instant quoting + Stripe deposits + pipeline)

- Recruitment & Onboarding (ATS + provisioning triggers + AI RSA document scanning)

- Commission dashboards

- Appraisals

- Marketing calendar

- Client image library with consent

- Manager/Director dashboards with AI reporting

- In-Store FOH (VIP alerts, drink orders to bar, tabs, call log)



WHAT YOU'LL INTEGRATE (THIS IS THE REAL JOB)



- Zenoti (CRM/POS — fixed): sales data reads, client writes, group bookings, gift-card deposits, complaints. No pre-built connector exists — custom API work via backend functions.

- Deputy (rostering — fixed): new-hire creation, compliance reads, news-feed posts.

- LearnWorlds (LMS — fixed): auto-enrolment, completion webhooks.

- Klaviyo + Shopify: client/segment sync from Hub + Zenoti.

- Stripe, Google Workspace, Claude API (in-app assistant + AI reporting).



YOU ARE



- Strong on REST APIs, webhooks and OAuth — comfortable reverse-engineering vendor APIs with patchy docs.

- Experienced with Base44 or comparable (Retool/Bubble) including backend functions — and honest about when low-code isn't enough.

- A clean data modeller — you can turn a spreadsheet-sprawl business into one relational schema.

- Pragmatic and phase-driven: ship value in weeks, prove risk early, don't over-engineer.

- Used to non-technical stakeholders; you build so an internal owner can run it without you.



HOW TO APPLY



Send:

- Portfolio or CV

- One end-to-end platform/integration build you shipped for a real business

- A short note on how you'd approach an undocumented salon-software API in week one



We're a fast-paced Australian beauty brand with multiple locations across Sydney, expanding to Melbourne. We're building the infrastructure to match the ambition.
